name: agent-swarm help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:agent-swarm. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Save preset
entries.text: Saves this mix of agents and models so you can pick it again.

entries.title: Run
entries.text: Starts it now. Part of Agent swarm.

entries.title: Preview brief
entries.text: Previews brief. Part of Agent swarm.

entries.title: Enable audio
entries.text: Reads new group chat messages aloud as they arrive, one voice at a time, each agent in its own voice. Also: `swarm.mjs audio on`, the agent-swarm chat-audio-run command, the action agent-swarm.audio.on, or say "turn on group chat audio" in AmberX.

entries.title: This device
entries.text: Whether this browser or phone plays the audio. Turn it off to keep this device quiet while another one plays; the room setting stays on.

entries.title: Voices
entries.text: The voice cast every agent speaks with. "From the skin" uses the cast the active skin picks; otherwise the cast you choose here (a voice asset).

entries.title: Unmute all
entries.text: Every agent is read aloud again. Mute one agent with its switch above, or say "mute Kat".

entries.title: Try the voice
entries.text: Says a sample line in this agent's voice on this device, with the speed and pitch below.

entries.title: Use the cast's voice
entries.text: Drops this agent's own speed and pitch and goes back to the voice the cast gives it.
